title: Prime Minister congratulates Indian Junior Men’s Hockey Team on winning Asia Cup
text: Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister congratulates Indian Junior Men’s Hockey Team on winning Asia Cup Posted On: 13 SEP 2026 8:41PM by PIB Delhi The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has congratulated the Indian Junior Men’s Hockey Team on winning the Asia Cup with an emphatic 4-1 victory in the final. The Prime Minister described the achievement as remarkable and said that the feat reflects the immense talent of the young players. Shri Modi extended his best wishes to the entire team. The Prime Minister wrote on X; “Congratulations to our Junior Men’s Hockey Team on winning the Asia Cup with an emphatic 4-1 win in the final. It is indeed a remarkable achievement. This feat reflects the immense talent of our young players. Best wishes to the entire team!” Congratulations to our Junior Men’s Hockey Team on winning the Asia Cup with an emphatic 4-1 win in the final. It is indeed a remarkable achievement.
